title: CPF DevEx, quality gate and evidence pipeline
review_triggers: new external input or archive format
trust boundary or release publication change

assets.name: CPF product source and generated artifacts

trust_boundaries.name: operator supplied manifest/profile to CPF tooling
CPF tooling reading or writing repository-relative artifacts
CPF test tooling invoking target runtime or child process

mitigations.control: repository-relative path normalization and traversal rejection
allowlisted collection, secret masking and residual-secret fail-closed scan
argument-array child process execution without shell and explicit timeout
machine-readable result, hash and non-zero exit on contract violation

threats.abuse_case: crafted manifest reads files outside the approved collection root

residual_risk.reason: canonical resolve and root containment checks

threats.abuse_case: diagnostic bundle includes credentials, tokens or private keys

residual_risk.reason: text masking plus fail-closed residual scan; binary collection rejected

threats.abuse_case: performance profile injects shell metacharacters or unbounded process execution

residual_risk.reason: no shell, explicit argument array, timeout and target-owned profile review

threats.abuse_case: missing or malformed evidence is interpreted as a successful gate

residual_risk.reason: fail-closed exit codes and machine-readable evidence validation
